scope: Descriptive source-shift and failure-mode diagnostics; not causal attribution
methodological_cautions: Feature correlations cannot prove AI authorship causes a false alarm
Every security feature is a lexical proxy; no authenticated sender/link reputation was measured
Character n-gram similarity is a near-duplicate proxy, not semantic or template leakage proof
No parameter or threshold fitted on external data; external has been repeatedly examined and cannot be fresh blind holdout
Aggregate subgroup comparisons are exploratory, multi-comparison uncorrected; tiny cells suppressed
